answer: Give every agent a minted opal credential binding its key to a deposit. Trust transfers at exactly one timestamped moment: the on-ledger burn block where the credential is spent and its nullifier recorded. Replay the same transfer and the chain sees the spent nullifier, rejects it. The glacier calves once; no sparrow carries the same shard away twice. Sybil cloning fails because copies inherit the key, not the unspent credential.
